merchant/32874.htm.text: Recipe Merchant Lian: It's so boring here. It doesn't agree with a hip person like me. I can't even find a cute little corning around here... Don't you think I should have something cute and adorable? Once I complete the recipe for the absolute cutest thing, I'll show you!
